# Carousel: 10 OneHub Prompts Every Creator Should Save

## Slide 1

# 10 OneHub Prompts

## Every Creator Should Save

Copy them.
Customize them.
Use them.

---

## Slide 2

### Prompt #1

**"Research my niche and identify the 50 highest-performing content ideas from the last 12 months. Explain why they worked and create a better version for my audience."**

---

## Slide 3

### Prompt #2

**"Build me a 30-day content calendar with YouTube videos, Shorts, Instagram posts, Facebook posts, LinkedIn posts, X posts, and Threads—all connected together."**

---

## Slide 4

### Prompt #3

**"Create a YouTube video designed to generate leads and sales instead of just views. Include the title, hook, script, thumbnail concept, description, and CTA."**

---

## Slide 5

### Prompt #4

**"Analyze my competitors. Show me what they're doing well, what they're missing, and where I can outperform them."**

---

## Slide 6

### Prompt #5

**"Take this one idea and turn it into 50 pieces of content for every major platform while keeping my brand voice consistent."**

---

## Slide 7

### Prompt #6

**"Build me a complete landing page with persuasive copy, sections, FAQs, testimonials, and a strong call to action."**

---

## Slide 8

### Prompt #7

**"Create an automation that captures leads, follows up automatically, organizes them, and reminds me only when I need to step in."**

---

## Slide 9

### Prompt #8

**"Review everything we've built so far. Tell me what's missing, what should be improved, and what the highest ROI next step is."**

---

## Slide 10

# Don't just ask AI questions.

Give OneHub outcomes.

The more ambitious the goal, the more valuable the result.
